text: Who has more power... the boss everyone fears... or the boss nobody wants to lose?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Two thinkers, centuries apart... and neither gives the easy answer.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli said it's safer to be feared than loved... if you must choose. But never... be hated.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He wrote... the best possible fortress is... not to be hated by the people.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Walls, titles, money... none of it saves you if your people want you gone.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rumi looks inside the walls. In essence... he turns from the battle outside to the battle within.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: His words... the true lion is he that breaks himself.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: A team captain. Best player on the pitch. One bad call... he shoves the referee. Red card. The final... without him.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Nobody beat him. He beat himself.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: So who wins? Machiavelli guards the walls. Rumi guards the gate inside. Real power needs both... and it starts inside.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Today, catch one urge... to snap, to quit, to scroll... and don't obey it. Once.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Which battle is harder for you... outside or inside? Comment below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... and be the true lion.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
